In the background, colorful banners with large text are visible under a grey sky. (2) Three elderly cartoon characters are presented in a line against an outdoor background with a single green tree. The leftmost character wears a pink patterned top, the middle one a red-and-white striped tank top, and the rightmost a white tank top; they exhibit neutral to stern expressions. (3) The character in the striped tank top raises their arms, revealing extremely loose skin under the armpits. The scene shifts to three characters jumping from a high structure into a blue sky with white clouds, using their underarm skin like wings to glide. Lines indicate fast motion. (4) The news anchor returns, now standing in front of a stadium background filled with simplified crowd figures. She is interviewing a male character in a green shirt and tie who appears to be a medical professional, holding the microphone toward him.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience through a satirical parody of a reality sports competition featuring elderly people with supernatural physical traits. It uses the absurdity of the character designs and the high-energy news broadcast style to generate humor.
